Control Resonant is a great game

Control Resonant hides its richest narrative in a mountain of in‑game reports, memos, and redacted files. The Federal Bureau of Control’s bureaucratic UI turns paperwork into a gameplay layer, rewarding players who dig into PDFs, audio logs, and hidden love stories with world‑building details that most miss.

Pokémon card resellers have turned collecting into an

After a viral video showed creator Natalie Roush flaunting unopened premium Pokémon packs, the community erupted over alleged stolen inventory and sky‑high resale prices. The incident exposed how bots, automated purchasing scripts, and influencer hype now dominate a hobby once driven by casual trade, turning the secondary market into a high‑frequency, profit‑first arena.
